note: Both sets capture the main claims accurately: negative damping from the generator-torque controller in Region 3, the derivative/proportional/integral term effects, and the Ref. [10] design targets (ωφn = 0.6 rad/s, ζφ = 0.6–0.7). Set A, however, contains two redundant pairs of claims (the second-order response claim appears twice and the generator-torque negative-damping claim appears twice), adding trivial duplication without new information. Set B keeps the same substantive content with only one duplicated claim and slightly cleaner quotes (e.g., 'Ref. [10] recommends neglecting the derivative gain'). Set A's extra condition 'active pitch-to-feather wind turbine' is supported by the text, so it is not an error, just more verbose.
